dataset_name: Davidson et al. (ICWSM 2017) Hate Speech & Offensive Language Benchmark

taxonomy.0: hate_speech (violence, dehumanization, or incitement targeting protected attributes)
taxonomy.1: offensive_language (profanity, aggressive or crude phrasing not targeted at protected classes)

limitations_and_bias_notes: Model is calibrated on Twitter discourse. Performance may degrade on platform-specific slang or long-form posts. Known risk: High-frequency African American Vernacular English (AAVE) terms may receive elevated false positive offensive scores as documented in Davidson et al. (2017) and Sap et al. (2019). Use for decision-support only.
